title: Vercel AI Gateway serves Baseten Mammoth-1 and Elephant-1 free through October 27
detail: Vercel made Baseten's Mammoth-1 (27B) and Elephant-1 (9B) decision models available on AI Gateway for one week, with free access through October 27. The model names are baseten/mammoth-1 and baseten/elephant-1. The changelog entry states that decision calls appear in logs and count toward budgets alongside other model requests. The page does not print a rate for either model after the free period.
impact: Decision-model traffic sent to these two models costs nothing until October 27. The page gives no post-promotion rate, so any workload built on them has an unknown cost after that date.
